name: Obsidian marketing homepage by obsidian.md
description: A near-black page carried almost entirely by product vignettes: the hero, the bento grid, the sync card and the docs mock are all real-looking UI built in DOM, so the app itself is the imagery. Hierarchy comes from a strict type scale (oversized headline with terminal period → 40px section heads → 15px gray body) and hairline rgba-white borders on #1a1a1f cards; the single purple accent is rationed to buttons, links, toggles and one gradient-framed sync panel. Rhythm alternates alignment section by section — left-aligned hero, split claim-stack, centered bento, text/mock splits, a centered CTA — before closing on a dense five-column footer.
